```yaml
name: Version Uploads
on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - main
      - master
jobs:
  upload-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build
      - name: Upload version
        uses: bobheadxi/deployments@v1
        with:
          step: start
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          env: staging
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          desc: "Version upload for ${{ github.ref }}"
      - name: Deploy to CDN
        run: |
          # Placeholder for actual deployment logic
          echo "Deploying version ${{ github.sha }} to CDN"
          # In a real implementation, this would upload to your CDN or artifact storage
      - name: Update deployment status
        uses: bobheadxi/deployments@v1
        with:
          step: finish
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          env: staging
          status: success
          deployment_id: ${{ steps.start_deployment.outputs.deployment_id }}
```
